ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast pixel distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) central core and high-intensity (white) distal lobes, with an estimated ratio of 60% low-intensity to 40% high-intensity pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white areas are mapped to the outer distal sections of both lobes. The central and proximal regions form a single contiguous low-intensity black mass. Fine-grained transitional mottling is present at the interface of these zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex and an interior angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing boundary exhibiting continuous low-amplitude serrations across the left span and high-amplitude, jagged peaks with deep valleys at the far right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge boundary, sweeping dorsally toward the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detected high-contrast white pixel clusters on the distal right tip and scattered circular white spots along the proximal margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned, high-contrast white linear marks (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the low-intensity central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake mark scarring throughout the central fluke; significant irregular indentation and tissue loss at the right-side distal trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, isolated low-intensity dark spots (pigment flecks) embedded within the high-intensity white areas on both the left and right lobes.
